Wounds from Metal Blades
Various Wounds

Examine the patient to determine whether the wound is shallow or deep; each case has its prognosis for life or death. If the intestine protrudes once, it is the large intestine — observe it daily. First, do not allow the intestine to become necrotic; treat accordingly to allow the intestine to heal.

If there is abdominal pain and shortness of breath, and the patient cannot eat or drink, death is likely. If the intestine protrudes, remove it the same day; trim away necrotic tissue and treat the intestine to allow healing.

Suture as by the standard method, then return the intestine inside. If the intestine is in two segments and hard to see, smear blood on it to reconnect the parts continuously. Use large grains of barley to measure; remove necrotic portions and treat the intestine so it heals.

Using half the method, after suturing, wash and clean the wound. If the patient cannot drink, use barley to measure, remove necrotic portions and treat the intestine so it heals.

Gradually push the intestine in and return it inside. If the intestine is in two segments and can be seen, smear blood on it and reconnect it continuously. Use two large barley grains to measure; remove and trim necrotic tissue and treat the intestine to allow healing.

After soaking, then allow the patient to gradually take in fluids. For metal blade wounds where much blood is lost: stop the bleeding; the patient must not speak at length or laugh.

Do not engage in movement or exertion — movement leads to death. Salty and sour foods and alcohol are prohibited. Also, use hemostatics. The patient must not speak at length, shout, or laugh.

Conditions that are difficult to treat or untreatable: If the wound from a metal blade penetrates into the lung, or if the intestine is totally severed — death is inevitable. Of seven such patients, only two may survive.

Untreatable Conditions:
Difficult to treat; left-side intestinal wounds penetrating inward — total intestinal severance results in immediate death; of two cases, perhaps one in seven may survive.

Pulse Indicators for Metal Wounds (Sword/Weapon Injuries)

In medicine, when the pulse is completely deficient and not full (shi), the condition is untreatable. If the lower abdomen is injured and the yang interior is damaged, this is also untreatable. When wounds are numerous and extensive, treatment is also not feasible.

When medication is given, if the pulse has completely dissipated, treatment may still be possible. In elderly patients, wounds penetrating from the shoulder area through to the interior are critical. Injuries that have penetrated deeply inward to the spine and the interior of the bowels are also very serious.

When a wound causes bleeding and the pulse is deep and small, but a large pulse indicates survival. A rapid and full pulse in one who has been stabbed and is bleeding indicates death.

When a wound causes excessive blood loss, a vacuous, fine, or large pulse indicates survival. A rapid, full pulse in a stabbed patient who is bleeding indicates death.

When a small wound becomes infected and the pulse is fine, if it then becomes large, death occurs within seven days. Superficial wounds are difficult to heal. When the pulse of a metal wound is such that blood can still flow out, there is hope.

When a serious wound causes the pulse to become large, unresponsive and without equilibrium, and if blood continues to pour out, the pulse condition indicates that the patient may still bleed further.

For wounds where the pulse cannot be broken — when there is flooding and harmonizing — if the intestines protrude outside the abdomen, the entire bowel must be carefully sutured back; this is extremely difficult for a physician. If it is severed, suturing may not be possible.

Treatment Method for Intestinal and Abdominal Injuries

Apply fat and ointment. If the skin remains intact, clean the area with oil and apply medicinal herbs such as mugwort. Wait until living tissue adheres. Stop bleeding and dissolve putrefaction. Then apply the herbal powder and administer internal medicine.

If the intestines and abdomen have both prolapsed, use herbal decoctions and wait for the tissue to become viable, then cover with prepared stone (mineral preparation), suture the abdomen — but do not suture the peritoneum to the external intestines. Administer internal medicine.

Gold Wound (Jinchang) Treatment: First, one should regulate the blood. If there is much stasis, nourish and break up stagnant blood, and relieve pain as the primary aim. Use Fuyuan Huoxue Decoction, Yiyuan Powder, Huarui Stone Powder — choose and apply as appropriate. In difficult cases, disperse the blood stasis. If there is accumulated stasis, first draw out the wound and remove the diseased blood from within. If there is blood accumulation, there will necessarily be constipation and stagnation; one must promote free flow and not allow the two orifices to become obstructed. After this, regulate the intestines.

Medicines for Stopping Bleeding, Generating Flesh, and Closing Wounds: If bleeding is excessive, collect the blood [stop it], apply powder to the mouth of the wound. White resin (baijiaoXiang) is especially effective. Old yellow minium (huangdan), bark decoctions, wash with white water, apply yunshi powder mixed with blood powder. In summer months, apply thinly laid over single cloth to keep flies away. Apply white yunshi powder mixed and fixed, white salt compressed into pieces — select and use as the sound [condition] dictates.

Arrows, Arrowheads, and Blades Lodged in Bones and Vessels That Will Not Come Out: After twenty days they will emerge on their own. Iron clam extract; also mouse brain applied externally; also elephant [brain]; also fine phoenix [feather]; mixed one part, half of white money (money equivalent), Banxia (Pinellia) in equal parts, ground and taken orally as powder, three doses each time until [it comes out]. Apply fire to draw it; with this method use iron smoke ash mixed and applied to the eyes — all cases have [resolved]. In one instance, a person alone in a room cut and ground [it]; when the strength was insufficient and the wound not yet healed with the metal fragment still lodged, the powder was taken, and eventually after a long time cutting it came out again.

Use the hand to lift away the plaster and bandage. There is no harm in also taking medicine — this is the Open-Pass medicine. Do not allow the two orifices (bowels and bladder) to become obstructed. Thereafter regulate the intestines.

Insert internally and sew with thread; continue taking free-flow-promoting medicine; remove [the stitches]; thereafter regulate the intestines.

Emergency Remedies (救急方)

[Top section - general indications:]
For gold-edge wounds (sword/knife wounds) and various serious injuries with pain and distress in the abdomen; for battle wounds of extreme severity where the person loses consciousness.

Take vinegar decoction, mix and drink it; the blood inside the abdomen will come out and the patient will recover. Also for those severely wounded in battle who have lost consciousness: use boy's urine, drink while still warm; this will cause the blood to come out and the patient will recover. Even those on the verge of death may revive.

Huoxue San (活血散 - Blood-Activating Powder)

For knife wounds causing the abdomen to split open with the intestines protruding. Ingredients: Danggui (Angelica sinensis), Chuanxiong (Ligusticum chuanxiong), Baizhi (Angelica dahurica), each equal parts. For every three qian, take warm with wine. This formula has been proven effective for all knife and sword wounds, as well as injuries from falls and strikes.

Huayao Shi San (花藥石散 - Flower Medicine Stone Powder)

Take four liang of huayao stone, crush it finely, heat it with charcoal fire, roast overnight, let cool, collect the dried medicine. Grind finely and for each dose take one da (large measure), add to wine, decoct and simmer, mix well and drink.

This medicine is used when injuries from knife wounds, falls, and blows cause blood to accumulate internally. If the blood has become lodged in the organs causing pain, swelling, and blockage, this medicine will dissolve and transform the stagnant blood internally. Those who are on the verge of death from severe injury should take this medicine urgently; thereafter the situation will improve.

Treats wounds from metal blades and knives, cuts, falls from heights into water, injuries from stones and lime; used for stagnant blood and bruising.

Oyster (蠣蛄)
Mulberry leaves ground into powder and applied dry cannot be spoken of as gold [i.e., it is invaluable]. To stop pain, apply mulberry wood ash. For an arrowhead lodged in the throat that will not come out: take the juice from the oyster's diaphragm and drip it on — within three to five [applications] one will feel relief. If the arrowhead remains in the flesh and will not come out, combine the oyster diaphragm with sulfur, grind together, and apply. For blood impediment (血痺) caused by an arrowhead lodged in the bone that cannot be conveniently extracted: heat it slightly with the herb, then apply a plaster made by grinding together oyster and baodou (croton seed), and coat the area.

Ant (螞蟻)
For wounds from arrowheads that have entered the bone causing impediment and cannot be extracted: use a formula with ant heads ground into powder; the drug will draw out itching from within, emanating fragrance; apply a muscle-regenerating plaster to coat.

Scallion (蔥)
Immediately stop bleeding from metal wounds: because metal injures the teeth causing swelling and pain together with bleeding, take scallion leaves, cook until soft, grind into a paste, apply — the bleeding will stop immediately and recovery follows.

[This page from the Dongui Bogam, Herbal Medicine volume, describes methods for treating bone injuries, fractures, and dislocations. The following is a translation of the readable portions:]

Pain entering from outside — method for when [the condition] has entered the interior of the body. When [the bone] must be returned to its original position, one must first store the medicine, keep the limb bent or straight as appropriate, and not strike or jostle it. Then use it once [as directed].

For fractures entering the cold [regions of the body], there are [conditions occurring at] the eighteenth or nineteenth [stage], requiring [special treatment].

When on one side the border has become bent and not straight, or if a knife is used to cut and open [the area], or if powder is used to wash the bone, bone clamps and bone fragments — for those whose bones are fragmented, one must keep them bent and straight, and must not strike or jostle them. Use Blood-Activating Powder (活血散) and Bone-Joining Powder (接骨散) and Bone-Joining Pills (接骨丹).

For bones that have flipped upward over one or two days, for finely fragmented bones: use scissors to trim away the fragmented bone, remove the flesh, use bone forceps to clamp and fix the bone. Then apply the Bone-Joining Method externally. Use Achyranthes Grove Powder (牛膝林散) method. Afterwards use Vitex Scatter (夏荊散), then use Bone-Joining Powder and Bone-Joining Pills to reconnect the bone.

Caowu Powder (草烏散):
For bone realignment and sudden reduction — the medicinal herb itself. For connecting bones: use Nine Bone Clamps to fix the bone. Purple Gold Pellet (紫金丹), [applied to] the skin. This medicine connects bones and pastes Purple Inner Gold Pellet inside; externally apply Achyranthes Grove Powder method. Use Bone Powder Pills (骨散丹) to join the bones.

[Preparation method for a formula using] two portions of Chuanzi (川苧), half portion of Egret Horn (鷺角), two qian (錢), smelted and refined into half portion of Gypsum (石膏), white — this medicine joins bones and forms a paste.

If one says [the patient] has chills: use a knife to cut open [the area], or scissors to remove the sinew, using府 [the method] when the patient cannot feel pain in the area — the bone is struck until the hand can set the bone, then iron [instruments are used]; afterwards rinse with salt water and apply medicine.

For anesthesia [麻]: afterwards use clamps to fix [the bone], extract [it], then chisel open [the area], rinse, and if needed use salt water together with the medicine.

translation:
Awakening/Reviving Methods (醒服立)

Bone Splinting Method (夾骨法):
Use small toads (four), jade tendon bark, internal dispersing [herb], three parts saltpeter, one liang of fresh ginger, one portion of wine lees — apply to the site of the fracture or injury.

Activate Blood Powder (活血散):
For treating fractures and injuries, fry mulberry bark and bean powder until purple in color. Mix with one measure of freshly drawn water to form a thick paste and apply. Alternatively apply with warm rice wine vinegar.

Bone-Setting Pill (接骨丹):
Angelica root 7.5 qian, Ligusticum (Chuanxiong) 3 qian, Myrrh, Drynaria (bone-knitting herb), Frankincense 5 qian, Aconite (Chuanwu) 1 qian, Costus root, old bronze coins, yellow incense, paper patch, pine [herb] 6 liang. If the bones are shattered and sinews are rotted: use the above two and a half liang portions. Prepare with oil and wood into a paste, spread on oil paper and apply to the affected area. If both bones are fractured and sinews are decayed, use this recipe to restore them.

Two-Fresh Paste (二生膏):
Treats fractures and injuries to the hands and feet. Fresh and processed rehmannia (one piece), fresh ginger 4 liang. For injuries with sinew decay, protruding sores, and damaged intestines.
For shoulder pain that is unbearable: stir-fry while hot, wrap in cloth, and apply as a compress to the injured area to treat swelling, sores, and damaged sinews. Beeswax, rub with oil on paper, heat/moxibust, sprinkle a layer of costus root powder, then again apply fresh rehmannia as a patch.

translation:
This page describes several traditional medicinal formulas for treating traumatic injuries such as fractures, torn sinews, and bone injuries:

**Glutinous Rice Paste (糯米膏)**
Apply to the affected area. For fractures, torn sinews, and broken bones: take 1 sheng of glutinous rice and half a sheng of soap pods (皂角), ground finely. Mix with wine to form a paste and apply.

**Yan Dou San (炎斗散)**
For the affected area. Treats traumatic bone and joint injuries. Ingredients: 1 coin-weight of bone marrow; 1 piece of croton seed (巴豆), fired and skin removed; self-tempering copper (自然銅), fired, half a portion; mix with wine and take orally.
The copper is quenched in vinegar seven times. Also use: raw frankincense (乳香) and myrrh (沒藥), each half a portion, self-tempering copper fired. Grind into powder, mix with wine and take. Wrap with cotton cloth, cover well. When fractures occur, drink warm clear wine and rest.

**Moyak Gangseong Dan (没藥降聖丹)**
For fractures and trauma: quench in vinegar repeatedly. Wrap affected area with cotton cloth; cover carefully — this method is especially effective. At the time of the injury, drink warm clear wine to revive the patient.
Ingredients: aconite root (川烏), cnidium (川芎), fresh ginger (生薑), ground beetles (蟲), white [ingredient], Chinese angelica (當歸), frankincense (乳香) — grind separately. Decoct, remove dregs, add sumuwood (蘇木). Take warm on an empty stomach. Each dose: one liang.

Single Remedies

Copper Filings (Chidongseol / Red Copper Filings)
Nine to four kinds, ten [conditions].
Pound and apply after fresh [injury]; or for nine applications, finely grind and mix with warm wine to treat fractures and trauma. Take red copper, burn it in fire, quench with vinegar seven times, then grind finely; mix with eastern wine [rice wine] and take together — this drives [the medicine] into the bone. Natural Copper (Jayeon-dong)
For fresh [injuries] after two-tiger [period], treats bone fractures and breaks. Each half-coin's worth [in weight], burn in fire and quench seven times, then grind finely, level with water; mix with warm wine and take. Then use to rub the painful area. Take together to regulate. Apply by rubbing to the area of pain. This medicine: newly burn and quench — it may be used, though it has some toxicity. Observe whether [the patient responds positively].

Mimosa Bark (Hap-hwan-pi / Albizia bark)
Primarily promotes bone regeneration. One category: two liang. For fractures, take one coin's worth, dry-fry it; it can knit bones. Day by day the bone regenerates. Use Huangqi [astragalus] four liang; [treats] traumatic injuries. [Use] mustard seed.

Fresh Rehmannia (Saeng-ji-huang)
Steam until soft and thoroughly cooked, wrap [around the injury]. Change daily; the bone is renewed day by day, regenerating. Replace with fresh rehmannia [daily].

Dipsacus (Sokdan / Teasel Root)
Immediately upon fracture, take internally; it can reconnect broken bones and sinews. Take the juice and drip/wash [over the injury].

Calamus Root (Seonschanggeun / Sweet Flag Root)
[Used for] sores and swellings. Apply to the center [of the wound]. Seal over the painful area. [Change] every three days. For broken sinews, take the root, extract the juice, and drip/wash [over the injury].

[Regarding Gu toxin:] When a person's name is used in Gu sorcery, the person who placed the Gu poison takes the victim's name and performs rituals at a shrine. The afflicted person should rest lying down. Symptoms include abdominal pain, palpitations, and internal bleeding. The treatment involves detoxifying the Gu. Effective remedies include: Powder of Powdered Arsenic, Purple-Gold Pellets (Zi Jin Dan), the Miraculous Elixir, the Solitary Victory Powder, the Ten-Thousand Illness Powder, the National Disease Antidote Drink, which causes vomiting or purging of the Gu toxin.

Tai Yi Zi Jin Dan (Supreme Unity Purple-Gold Elixir)

Also called Zi Jin Ding (Purple-Gold Lozenge) and also called Wan Bing Jie Du Dan (Ten-Thousand Illness Antidote Elixir). It treats Gu toxin, epidemic toxins that cause death, and all toxic substances from ox and horse meat, and all Gu poisons.

[Ingredients include:] Mountain miasma toxins, processed with the skin and oil removed, various fox, raccoon-dog, and rat [derived ingredients], two hundred liang, combined with ox palm, sliced...

[Processing:] The glutinous rice paste, seven liang in weight, formed into pills the size of paulownia seeds. Each day add one qian dissolved in soup, with four qian of the prepared ingredients. Grind and work the formula on auspicious days avoiding inauspicious times, prepared in a clean room.

[Uses:] Dissolve in water to treat all malign influences. When serpents or dogs encounter the dissolved medicine in water, they immediately become sober/repelled.

For aromatic and fasting preparations: given to women to take, to warm those who are cold at the head; also dissolved in water and administered. When serpents or dogs encounter the water in which it is dissolved, they immediately recover/are repelled.

Take on the Double Fifth (Dragon Boat) Festival at noon. Use seven liang mixed with [auspicious day formulas]. Prepare in a clean room at the correct time, avoiding inauspicious hours.

Poisons from the Flesh of Various Birds and Fowl

For poisoning from eating chicken meat: drink glutinous rice water (泔) or warm wine. Also for forest bird poisoning: grind and extract the juice of male flesh, drink one qian or one cup; grind intensely with water and apply the kidney ash mixed with water and eat it. Also for poisoning from wild birds or wild animal meat: burn the kidney to ash, mix with water and take it orally. Also: grind rhinoceros horn powder with water and take one qian dissolved in one cup of water. Also: for poisoning from fish and wild animal meat cooked with black beans, drink winter melon juice — this is most effective. Also for coastal seafood poisoning: drink indigo juice.

Poisons from Various Fish and Crabs

Boil fish skin, drink the resulting juice. Also boil vegetable roots with beans and drink the juice. For crab poisoning: drink fresh lotus root juice; this is effective. Also drink fresh perch (鱸) juice for poisoning. For fish poisoning, drink concentrated winter melon juice. Also drink fish broth — this is also quite effective. For crab poisoning, orange peel juice is most effective. For fish poisoning, drink concentrated winter melon juice. Also, reed root boiled with beans — drink the juice and recover immediately. ○ For large amounts causing illness: use a formula with water, phellodendron bark to treat the stomach and intestines...

For all of the above poisons: take the juice of crab and drink it all at once per day. ○ For scale-fish poisoning, take until recovered.

For failure to digest all manner of food and drink: stimulate digestion of meat in the body. For failure to digest raw fish (膾), which leads to accumulation masses (癥結): [use] dried dog meat preparations. Repeat seven times eating the meat until fully cooked and digested. ○ After three to five repetitions, eat the meat again with broth until digested. ○ Repeat the dried preparations three times until relieved. Use sulfur stone several times with aged [preparation], eat quickly with half portions of fish and crucian carp steamed together...

Poisoning from Melon and Fruit:
Burn [the remedy] to preserve its nature, grind into powder, mix with wine and take. Take [it] as a powder mixed with wine and drink. If poisoned by something in food or drink, also borrow melon bone [gua gu], apply as a paste and take. If one has eaten too much of a certain fruit and suffers bloating, urgently take powdered cinnamon bark (guì mò). If after eating rice, vegetables, and other foods one suffers bloating and urgency, take cinnamon [preparation]. For peach poisoning causing vomiting and illness, take the juice. For general peach poisoning, use [the following] to treat: take the large white [remedy]...

Poisoning from Vegetables and Greens:
For poisoning from various raw vegetables, licorice root (gancao) decoction is excellent. Also, black chicken broth is good. For meat poisoning, bitter ginseng (kushen) and rabbit [preparations] are used. Take two sheng, fry in much oil, drink the juice immediately; this cures. Take one sheng, immediately decoct until dry; induces vomiting and cures.

Alcohol (Burned Wine) Poisoning:
When one notices after drinking alcohol that one is excessively drunk and the intestines are affected—the body should be immersed [in cold water], clothes removed, salt applied and rubbed over the body. If there is vomiting, diarrhea, severe cramping, dizziness, and loss of consciousness, do not rush to revive; at the very beginning [of treatment]...

[Right column treatments:]
For melon/fruit poisoning: Take fresh indigo (lan), cinnamon, [aquilaria] fragrant wood, licorice—each one portion—decoct in water and take. [Various remedies using] cinnamon bark, mume, indigo, licorice, jade [green] leek, large beans, and other herbs are also used for these conditions.

Tofu Poisoning
Take the juice of turnip greens, pry open the mouth, and pour it in. If it cannot be kept down, crush fresh ginger into water and frequently place it in the mouth.

Take liver and bile juice, pry open the mouth and pour it in. If the person does not wish to die, have a new person prepare a drink — the patient will recover immediately and be at peace.

Have the person eat apricot kernels; boil in water, grind, and take the juice; decoct it and drink the broth. Also take radish peel, boil and take the juice. If fresh is unavailable, then [use dried].

Noodle Poisoning
Have the person eat apricot kernels; boil in water, grind and take the juice and drink it. Also take the bark of Lycium root, boil and take the juice. If fresh is unavailable, then [use dried].

Grind rhinoceros horn in water to make a thick concentrated juice, and take it as a drink or decoction. Also pound calamus root in water, take the juice and drink it. Take the yolk of a young chicken egg, mix with powder, swallow with water.

Mix red adzuki bean powder with water, drink immediately — recovery follows. [Note regarding shoes/footwear medicine].

Also drink blue indigo juice. Mix lead powder with water and take it.

Also boil rehmannia root, take the juice, and drink it repeatedly.

General Treatment for All Kinds of Poisoning
Take all of the above-named remedies, boil in water, take the juice and drink. Also mix lead powder and indigo juice with water and drink. Also take the yolk of a young chicken egg mixed with powder and swallow with water.

Named Luan Cha — take it below [in the stomach]; it will exhaust [the poison] from the heart. Gall-nut [Gallnut of Chinese Sumac] and licorice root, grind to an extremely fine powder, lightly dry-fry.

Refined Humanite (dried human urine sediment) treats poisoning from all substances. The new water elixir [Sinsu-dan], prepared and taken with water, is most effective — take three qian [a unit of weight].

There is a condition called Water Toxin (水毒), also known by the name "Creek Fever" (溪溫). These insects move through sand and infect people. The toxin acts like iron pellets, with five colors appearing on all four sides of the affected area. Once it enters and causes disorder, if not treated with a hot decoction immediately, the person dies within three days. The Creek Fever bath treatment: one must quickly address the onset of red marks; the treatment method uses a meat broth decoction. If not treated promptly, death occurs within three days. translation:
Sudden Malignant Attack (Zhong E / 中惡)

[Opening section on diagnosis and classification, mentioning pharmaceutical compounds including realgar (砒), alum (礬), and various treatments]

When a person is suddenly struck by malignant or noxious influences, whether upon going outdoors, entering a privy, or encountering such forces at night — and two people are walking together yet one does not notice — the victim may suddenly lose consciousness, their eyes may roll back, and the vital breath of the room becomes corrupted.

Treatment: Do not move the patient abruptly. First burn mugwort or Aquilaria wood to stabilize the vital energy. Suhe Fragrant Pills (蘇合香丸) or Anxixiang (安息香) may be administered directly. The Suhexiang Yuan (蘇合香元) formula with Shenjing powder and refined cinnabar with ginger decoction may also be used.

For powder of Zaojiaofen (皂粉): dissolve in warm wine and administer below. Then, following stabilization, use Guisu (歸蘇) decoction. First apply the Disu method, then administer Huo Xiang (藿香) burned preparation. Do not allow the patient to be moved until stable.

Alternative method: Take fresh ginger juice; prick inside the nostrils with a needle to a depth of eight fen, grind five parts, mix with vinegar, take two doses daily; blood will emerge and the condition will improve. Also take fresh ginger decoction.

Another method: Use musk (麝香) applied to the nostrils; pierce deeply about eight fen; grind five parts with vinegar; take two doses per day; blood will flow and the condition will resolve.

translation:
Treating Death by Starvation

Twisted Intestine Sha (Cholera-like Condition)

[On starvation:]
When a person has starved during a famine year, if they have gone many days without food and are near death from hunger, one must first give them thin rice gruel frequently to drink, so as to moisten and nourish the intestines and stomach gradually. If one feeds them solid rice too quickly, the vital passages will naturally become blocked, the balance between hunger and fullness will be lost, and death may result.

[On Twisted Intestine Sha:]
This condition is similar to cholera. The pain arises from miasmic and wind-cold evil qi invading the body. Symptoms include: cramping abdominal pain, a sensation like being struck by mountain miasma, headache, nausea, vomiting, profuse sweating, and abdominal distension.

Treatment methods include: using moxa (mugwort) burned with oil to warm and stimulate the sha points; using a needle to prick and release dark or black blood at the sha points on the back; applying cupping or pressing techniques; burning paper near the affected areas; and administering decoctions to induce vomiting. The twisted intestine decoction may be used: bring it to a boil, administer it, and if vomiting is induced, that is the sign of effect. Needling the fingertips and toe-tips is also indicated, and hot salt water foot soaks may be used as well.

Sudden Death from Falling into a Well or Old Tomb

Among these, old tombs and deep wells may contain poisonous gases accumulated within. Before descending, release a chicken feather into the well; if it falls straight down, there is no poison. Before descending, take sulfur powder mixed with warmed wine and drink it.

If someone suddenly collapses and dies upon inquiry: immediately take a length of bamboo tube and draw water from the well. Use it heated with certain ingredients, discarding what is used. Give the person jade (or sulfur) powder dissolved in wine to drink.

If someone receives two qian [a unit of weight] of the substance and suddenly feels ill, takes it internally, and experiences abdominal pain with the urge to defecate: use water to dissolve realgar and sulfur powder, steeped in wine, to treat this.

Prepare a concentrated decoction of salt; have the person drink it all at once while sitting at the edge. Then use vinegar in eight layers of cloth, wrap the chest and abdomen, and apply heat and moist ginger to the body. Cut into pieces and apply to the affected areas.

Prepare a concentrated decoction of dried salt and hot water; wash the hands, feet, and chest of the patient thoroughly. Then bind with rope from above and below to stabilize.

If a person is at the side of the well and has been inside too long, the family members—host and guest alike—should use ropes tied above to lower a board wrapped with rope, commanding the person below.

The person may appear confused, having climbed but not yet stepped out of the well. The strange symptoms become apparent to the household master. Use rope to bind the person, lower and raise by rope, test whether the person responds, then command them upward.

If the person is dead, the body may appear bluish-black like a horse's broken bones, with sores and wounds visible. Use a dog: bind it with rope, lower it into the well, then raise it. Observe the results and treat accordingly.

[Note on a related condition:] In summer months, due to the heat, while sleeping, a snake may enter a person's ear, nose, or mouth.

[Treatment for snake entering the seven orifices:] If a snake enters the body through one of the seven orifices, urgently use a knife to wound the snake's tail, then insert Sichuan pepper and black pepper (two grains each) to plug the opening.

Take white bile of a large [animal], mix with thoroughwort (Ligusticum) and cinnamon heart, grind into powder, mix with honey — this is an excellent formula. Wash with hot water; use bean powder to wash dry oil stains easily. Mix with jade, also magnetite; apply jade juice to wash away dirt. Method for Dissolving Stone
With a knife, carve and engrave; the magpie combined with carving and engraving, using human skill, burned into the ground — this can also dissolve stone. [From the] Cham-rok (Toad Record).

Treating Smoke Poisoning: When residents flee and hide in stone chambers to escape smoke, they may be overcome by the fumes and fall into a daze or unconsciousness.
